messages:
Alex Chen: hey team — heads up I need to step out for a customer-facing call from 17:00-19:30, can someone swap primary with me for that window? I can take the 20:00-22:00 slot after the call if needed.
Maria Gupta: I can pick up 17:00-19:30, but quick check — we've had a few noisy pages on inference-gpu-allocator in the last hour. anyone on stable coverage right now? :thinking_face:
IncidentBot: ALERT summary: 3 pages in last 45m for inference-gpu-allocator (OOM-ish), highest severity P2, affected customers: alpha-beta, gamma-inc. Current pager status: acknowledged by Jon Reyes at 16:12, ongoing investigations.
Jon Reyes: acked earlier and left a note in the incident channel — troubleshooting kernel mem allocation, looking at autoscaler flapping. will stay on until we stabilize, but happy to hand active primary to Maria if you two coordinate.
Leah Park: Maria — if you take primary, please ensure you have escalation rights for infra pager (level-2 SSH). quick checklist: 1) confirm you can see PagerDuty incidents, 2) has access to /etc/ops/keys if we need reboot, 3) know the runbook path.
Maria Gupta: I have PD on my phone and can access prod keys, but don't have the infra SSH key cached. can Jon or Alex walk me through a quick handoff so I can assume escalation?
Alex Chen: OK Jon — can you transfer escalation to Maria for the 17:00-19:30 window? I'll DM the meeting invite and then switch back in slate for the 20:00 slot.
Jon Reyes: doing it now. PD note: transferring escalation -> @Maria Gupta for incident group inference-prod.
Jon Reyes: (system) escalation transfer complete. Maria Gupta is now primary escalation for inference-prod.
Maria Gupta: got it — I can see PD escalation badge. thanks. quick runbook pointer?
OpsRunbookBot: Runbook: inference-gpu-allocator-triage v2.3 — https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/inference-gpu-allocator-triage
OpsRunbookBot: TL;DR steps: 1) check metrics (gpu_mem_free, pod_restarts) 2) inspect autoscaler events `kubectl get hpa -n inference` 3) if OOM on model-worker, restart with smaller batch config; fallback model: rwl-quant-small.
Maria Gupta: copying relevant snippet below for quick access:
```
# quick mem check
kubectl top pods -n inference | sort -k3 -nr
# restart worker with conservative batch
kubectl set env deploy/model-worker BATCH_SIZE=8 -n inference
```
Maria Gupta: also, if it goes P1 we should follow the escalation matrix (oncall -> infra -> netops). Jon, do you want me to take over the investigation thread while you're doing the deeper checks?
Jon Reyes: yes, please. I'll keep digging at kernel layer and post findings to the incident thread. if you need me to run a hot patch I can stand by.
Leah Park: small note — since Maria won't have the cached SSH key, use the temp jump key documented in the runbook if you need to reboot any nodes: `ssh -i /secure/jump/temp_key ops@jump-host`. ops-manager approves for 2h windows.
Maria Gupta: noted. I ran the quick mem check and saw one worker at 95% memory. I'll restart it with BATCH_SIZE=8 and follow up here.
Maria Gupta: restarted model-worker-12, monitoring logs — tailing: `kubectl logs -f model-worker-12 -n inference`
IncidentBot: EVENT update: restart of model-worker-12 initiated by Maria Gupta at 16:42.
Maria Gupta: after restart memory settled to 40-50%, no new pages in the last 6m. I'm keeping primary until 19:30 as agreed. Alex — can you confirm you'll pick up at 20:00?
Alex Chen: confirmed, I'll be back on primary at 20:00. swapping the rota now.
Maria Gupta: one more admin step — updating rota so the console shows current primary. use this command if anyone needs to change it later:
```
rotactl assign --team inference --primary "Maria Gupta" --from 2026-03-14T17:00Z --to 2026-03-14T19:30Z --note "midday swap for customer call"
```
Alex Chen: nice. I'm leaving a short handoff note in the oncall doc: `model-worker-12 restart stabilized, watching autoscaler, Jon has kernel-level investigation`.
Jon Reyes: adding: looked at dmesg — saw cgroup OOM notice around 16:05, likely tight memory budgets. suggest follow-up tomorrow to tune HPA target and checkpoint KV cache TTLs.
Leah Park: thanks all. Maria — if anything looks like customer impact (3+ users degraded), escalate immediately to P1 and ping #incidents.
Maria Gupta: will do. thanks for the quick swap everyone. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: appreciate it — carry on, I'll DM meeting notes and catch you at 20:00.
Leah Park: closing note — post-incident: add a small play to runbook about `BATCH_SIZE` quick-fixes so swaps like this are faster next time.
Maria Gupta: filed runbook PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pulls/42
Alex Chen: :rocket:
